title: Angles of elevation and depression
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:20Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 may adapt mat-elevation-depression, but is not highly sure, so to the Opus match check
2026-11-20T12:25:56Z match: Claude Opus 5.5 says reuse mat-elevation-depression, but its topic always comes to you

changes: Give the reason for equal elevation and depression as alternate angles between the parallel horizontal lines, in line with the brief and the NSW Stage 5 wording, rather than only as parallel horizontals.
match.reason: The bank point teaches the same idea at the right depth, but its card gives the equality reason without naming alternate angles, which the NSW Stage 5 brief uses.

confirm.reason: The bank point teaches exactly this idea, elevation and depression measured from the horizontal and equal as alternate angles between parallel horizontals, at a Year 9–10 depth, and both of its questions are fair for NSW Stage 5 students.
